description: Get the official NBP rate for one currency against PLN (Polish złoty) — the latest rate by default, or the rate in force on a historical date. Tables 'a'/'b' return the mid rate; table 'c' returns bid/ask. NBP publishes only on Polish business days — on weekends/holidays the request falls back to the most recent preceding publication; effectiveDate in the response shows the date actually used. Use nbp_rate_series for a multi-day history.

code.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, CHF). Case-insensitive.

date.description: Optional historical date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the latest rate.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh NBP fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

table.description: NBP table: 'a' (default) = official mid rates of ~35 major currencies, published every business day; 'b' = mid rates of ~115 less-traded currencies, published Wednesdays; 'c' = bid/ask (buy/sell) rates of major currencies, published every business day.

name: nbp_exchange_rate
title: NBP currency rate vs PLN
